art_direction: 一只无纹茶杯盛着倾斜海平面，珊瑚杯身与青蓝水面形成简洁不可能空间。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Center a plain coral teacup whose interior contains a miniature ocean horizon tilted at an impossible angle. The horizon should be a single dark blue line dividing a pale sky from turquoise water, contained entirely within the cup opening. Let one small cream sun sit close to that line. Show the cup in a shallow three-quarter view with a simple rounded handle and one flat shadow underneath. Use a light oatmeal ground. Avoid waves, boats, steam, or decorative patterns. Keep the surreal effect concentrated in the altered interior perspective, while the exterior cup remains an economical solid shape with no branding or lettering.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
